[EN] There was an old person of Ischia,
Whose conduct grew friskier and friskier.
She danced hornpipes and jigs,
And ate thousands of figs,
That lively old person of Ischia.Fold the poem.
[ES] Había una anciana en Ischia,
cuya conducta era cada vez más viva.
Bailaba danzas marineras y jigs,
y comía miles de higos,
esa animada anciana de Ischia.Fold the poem.
